references.text: The blessing of the basket and the kneading trough, in contrast to the curse in verse 17
The basket is used to carry the firstfruits to the Lord, showing its significance for the harvest
The kneading trough is mentioned in connection with the Israelites' departure from Egypt
Lack of bread and food as part of God's punishment for disobedience
The prophet Hosea describes how God removes grain, wine, and oil as punishment for apostasy
Haggai describes how the people harvest little due to disobedience to God
